title: Speed expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the particle's speed upon entering the magnetic field must be correct, e.g., v = qB(d² + L²)/(2mL).

title: Voltage expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the accelerating voltage U must be correct, e.g., U = qB²(L² + d²)²/(8mL²).

title: Magnetic force centripetal
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law to the circular motion, stating qvB = mv²/r.

title: Geometry in field
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the radius r, width d, and deviation L using the Pythagorean theorem: r² = (r - L)² + d².

title: Work-energy application
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the work-energy theorem to the electric field acceleration, stating qU = ½mv².

title: Algebraic solving
description: Optional Criteria: The solution shows clear algebraic steps to solve the simultaneous equations for v and U.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The final answers are presented with correct implied units (m/s and V).

title: Sign or geometry error
description: Pitfall Criteria: A common error is misidentifying the geometric relationship, e.g., using r² = L² + d² instead of the correct chord geometry.

title: Force balance mistake
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly stating the magnetic force law, e.g., using F = qvB sinθ with wrong angle, or misapplying centripetal acceleration.
